blurb: Guests fish for smallmouth bass and trout on various rivers including the French Broad, Nolichucky, South Holston, Tuckaseegee, and Watauga. Trips include float fishing in drift boats or self-bailing rafts and wade fishing in spring creeks and backcountry streams. Full day trips include a gourmet shore lunch and cover 6-10 miles of river.
